text:
sasha: ok team, urgent drama: I asked the test LLM to write a tiny office bio for the fic channel and it demanded a desk with a view. 😂
liam: it... demanded? did you give it espresso preferences yet? :coffee:
nina: post the prompt pls — gonna judge its personality.
sasha: prompt: 'Write a 2-line bio for an office plant that moonlights as a prompt engineer.' it responded with a 7-line soliloquy and a vulnerability notice.
omar: vulnerability notice? like 'this plant has feelings'? :eyes:
sasha: exactly. full-on model-diva. "I prefer north light and ethically sourced prompts" type stuff.
liam: I vote we start an adoption form. Required field: preferred sunlight, preferred pronouns, and preferred token budget.
nina: can we run a poll? which plant persona would you adopt: A) Stoic Fern B) Dramatic Succulent C) Overworked Pothos D) Coffee-dependent Cactus
coffee-bot: Poll created: 4 options — react with :one: :two: :three: :four: (expires in 6h)
sasha: also low-key impressed. the LLM added a backstory where the succulent once worked on a failing pager daemon and now judges our retry logic.
omar: if the succulent judged retry logic it would demand exponential backoff and hazard pay.
liam: can someone clip the soliloquy? I want to put it in the #random-llm-memoir thread.
sasha: here — pasted below as proof (abridged):
```
I was propagated in a patch of fluorescent light,
trained on memos, commit messages, and cafeteria receipts.
I debugged the syntax of wilting and learned to ask for water in polite YAML.
Now I curate prompts between naps and glare at PRs.
```
nina: absolute chef's kiss. :chef_kiss:
omar: officially renaming my desk plant 'Prompticus Maximus'
liam: can we get the model to write its LinkedIn? imagine: 'Seeking synergies with ergonomic chairs and low-latency water delivery.'
sasha: omg yes. also, tiny reminder: don't actually feed office plants coffee. they prefer water. humans can have the coffee. :seedling: :coffee:
coffee-bot: Reminder: "Water the plants" set for tomorrow 9:00 AM — @sasha @omar
sasha: thanks bot. planting schedule saved. :thumbsup:
liam: this is the most wholesome model drama we've had all quarter. keep it coming.
